summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss narrowed to $59.4M from $64.1M.
The net loss narrowed to $56.0M, or −$1.27 per share, from $61.0M. Operating cash flow was −$45.3M and free cash flow −$45.5M, versus −$55.1M.
sources: Immuneering Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We are a late-stage clinical oncology company with a limited operating history in developing pharmaceutical products…
We have incurred significant net losses for the past several years…
The regulatory approval processes of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and other comparable foreign regulatory authorities are lengthy…
We may encounter substantial delays in completing, or ultimately be unable to complete, the development…
The outcome of preclinical studies and earlier clinical trials may not be predictive of the success of later clinical trials…
Our current or future product candidates may cause adverse events, toxicities or other undesirable side effects when used alone…
strategy: Apply Our Deep Expertise of the MAPK Pathway to Develop Novel Therapies that Achieve Durable Outcomes…
Advance Atebimetinib Through Late-stage Clinical Development for the Treatment of Pancreatic Cancer
Advance Atebimetinib through clinical development for lung cancer and other tumor types
Progress Our DCI Pipeline to IND-Enabling Studies
Continue to Expand and Advance Our Platform and Portfolio of Product Candidates
